criterion: When details for a selected result fail to load, the dialog does not display stale or misleading data.

Removed the exact owned handler, pressed Retry, observed genuine HTTP 200 and the distinct 4 August record with 455 samples, then captured and inspected recovery.

Verified the handler was absent. Closed only the three test-created MS Teams tabs, removed only the added Automobile layer, and restored the pre-existing Surveyor layer, cluster tab, empty catalogue search and map camera to approximately -0.579309 / 51.432076 at zoom 18 (initial latitude 51.432074). reason: SIMULATED UI STATE: a browser-only HTTP 503 was injected for GET /api/platform/automobile/ms-teams-call/tests/131879769 after genuine test 132124168 had loaded. The target showed “Unable to load this MS Teams Call test” and Retry with no visible summary, charts or sample table from the previous test. Removed the exact handler; Retry returned genuine HTTP 200 and loaded test 131879769 with 455 samples. This proves client error presentation and recovery, not a naturally occurring backend failure. Failure-status provenance: RFC 9110 section 15.6.4, https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html#section-15.6.4. The injected JSON body is a synthetic non-success placeholder, not a claimed production error schema. This criterion asserts failed-load error presentation and stale-data exclusion, not a loading animation or project error-body contract.
